title: Automaton catalog index (catalog.json), spec v1
description: The index at the root of a catalog repository. Every entry is pinned to one commit, so an install always gets the files that were listed.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of this format. A reader refuses a higher major version than it knows.

id.description: The last segment of folder; unique in the catalog.

summary.description: One line for the store card.

folder.description: Path of the app folder from the repository root; no . or .. segments.

commit.description: Full SHA of the commit the app is installed from.

minServerVersion.description: Oldest server that can install the app.

permissions.description: Capabilities the app asks for. Asking never grants: an administrator approves each one on the installing server.

icon.description: Path inside the app folder (png, jpg, webp or svg, up to 512 KB), read at the pinned commit.
